description: Defines the Trade data class used as both the Room entity and domain model within a trading journal application, encapsulating trade details and computed profit/loss metrics.

classes.name: Trade
classes.description: Represents a single trade entry in the trading journal, including properties for trade details and computed profit/loss metrics.

methods.name: profitLoss
methods.description: Calculates the profit or loss for the trade, considering entry and exit prices, quantity, fees, and trade status.

methods.name: profitLossPercent
methods.description: Calculates the profit or loss percentage based on entry and exit prices.

methods.name: isWinningTrade
methods.description: Determines if the trade was profitable.
